title: Campus-half floor hardcodes `10` (= campus volume 1 × multiplier 10) while the total ask is catalog-derived — a single-source (ODN-5) violation that silently drifts on re-tune
evidence:
testing.expectf(t, campus_window_spawns >= 10*WINDOW*95/100,
		"the campus half must land: in-window campus spawns %d < %d (10/tick × WINDOW × 0.95)", campus_window_spawns, 10*WINDOW*95/100)
detail: N5 derives EXPECTED from the catalog (streaming volumes × multiplier × WINDOW) precisely so a re-tune cannot silently drift the pin; the campus floor restates the same ask as a literal `10`. A campus-volume or multiplier re-tune leaves the campus floor stale.
recommended_fix: Derive the campus ask like EXPECTED: sum `e.volume` for the campus-source streaming entry, then floor = campus_ask × multiplier × WINDOW × 95/100.

title: fold_check hardcodes boot's run setup (seed 42 / era 0 / fixture) instead of reading demos/boot.dem — duplicates the demo file and silently verifies a stale scenario if boot.dem drifts
evidence:
pp.run_init(&state, 42, cat.hash, cat.balance.logic_hz)
	state.era = 0
	seed_fixture(&state, &cat)
	before := len(state.events)
	pp.step(&state, 1, {}, &cat)
detail: The tool's proof is only valid against boot's actual tick-1, but its setup is re-stated as magic constants. If boot.dem's seed/era/fixture changes, fold-check still runs seed-42 and PASSES (verified: not fail-closed), proving a claim about a stale run.
recommended_fix: Parse demos/boot.dem via the shared parse_demo and use demo.seed / demo.era / demo.use_fixture to rebuild the setup, keeping the demo file the single source.

title: fold_check prints but never verifies the forward direction (new tick-1 == blessed manifest) despite the header comment claiming it is "cross-checked"
evidence: fmt.printfln("fold-check: new tick-1        %016x  (the blessed manifest must match)", new_tick1)
detail: The header says the NEW tick-1 is "cross-checked against the blessed manifest" (line 12-13), but the code only prints it; only the splice (reverse) direction is asserted. Forward divergence relies on the separate `harness run boot` T1 gate.
recommended_fix: Either pass the blessed tick-1 as an argument and assert new_tick1 == it, or soften the comment to say the value is printed for manual comparison.
